title: FEI Tribunal Decision — Operative Decision Withdrawal of Charges C25-0040  2025FT21 DENALI QH - Mr. Fahad WALEED (APR)
text:
OPERATIVE DECISION WITHDRAWING CHARGES
RENDERED BY THE FEI TRIBUNAL
21 May 2026
In the matter of
FÉDÉRATION EQUESTRE INTERNATIONALE (the “FEI”)
vs.
Mr. Fahad WALEED - Additional Person Responsible (Trainer) - (Ref. C25-0040) (the “APR”)
together the “Parties”
(Reference No. FEI Tribunal: C25-0040_(FEI Case number: Case 2025/FT21 DENALI QH)
COMPOSITION OF THE FEI TRIBUNAL PANEL:
Ms. Diane Pitts, (USA), Sole Panel Member
FEI Tribunal Reference: C25-0040 [FEI 2025/FT21 DENALI QH]
Person Responsible/ID/NF: Majed ALQAHTANI/10363591/KSA
Trainer/ID/NF: Fahad WALEED/10306368/KSA
Event/Date: CEI1* 100 - Riyadh (KSA), 24-26.04.2025
Event/Code: 2025_CI_0266_E_S_02
Date of sample collection: 26.04.2025
Prohibited Substance(s): Triamcinolone Acetonide
Bar Code Nos.: 1417731
1

THE DECISION
1) The FEI Tribunal Panel (the “Panel”) hereby sets aside the finding (dated 28 April
2026) of the violation of Article 2.1 of the Equine Anti-Doping and Controlled
Medication Regulations (the “EADCMRs”) against Mr. Fahad WALEED (APR).
2) The Panel lifts the Suspension imposed on the APR effective immediately;
3) The Panel sets aside the fine imposed on the APR;
4) The Panel sets aside the order for costs imposed on the APR;
5) This Decision is notified to the APR, to the FEI and to Equestrian Federation of Saudi
Arabia.
DECISION TO BE FORWARDED TO:
a. The Parties: Yes
b. Any other: No
FOR THE TRIBUNAL
_________________________________________________________________
Ms Diane Pitts, (USA) Sole Panel Member
